edits:
God-only attribute authoring uses `admitAttributeDeclaration` in the declaration boundary. It admits bounded definitions, permits presentation-only sequential revisions when no dependent action is active or queued, and rejects removal with live instance/source/action/frontier dependencies. Whole definition bytes are captured in saves, so retained saves retain their own pins. Atomic owner edits/initialization require manifest and per-attribute revisions; server admission also requires the current restore generation. No raw path, native-owner replacement or unit/resource reinterpretation is accepted. The technical APIs and reviewed World Agent `attribute`, `attribute-bindings` and `attribute-values` adapters share native admission and exact revision checks. The finite conversational write path is delivered; arbitrary host operators and broader authoring remain unsupported. Definition edits follow the [invention policy boundary](#invention-policy-boundary); ordinary attribute state edits do not create definitions.
Bundled human creation uses `worlds/base/world.ts`'s `createActor`. An explicit authored trait list is copied, including an intentionally empty list; only an omitted list samples three distinct entries from the [JSON trait bank](../packages/domain/src/worlds/base/config/traits.json) using saved RNG. Saved traits retain their copied descriptions unless an authorized identity edit changes them; bank edits do not reroll existing actors. Traits enter the character's permitted identity sentence in decision context, but do not themselves grant numerical bonuses or executable behavior. The residual `initializeActorTraits` startup hook still fills absent traits and is a compatibility-cleanup obligation under [DF04](maintainers/production-data.md#df04--retire-residual-compatibility-paths), not the supported loading contract. Only public trait descriptions cross the normal projection. The Character panel reads the player's own awareness/summary memory projection and bounded history; god-only inspection remains separately authorized.
files.summary: align authored traits and delivered reviewed attribute editing with current code
